Slack bot — install in 10 minutes

Turns on the Send PDF to Slack button in /app/pmo so plans land in #ai-pmo-plans as VCL-branded PDFs.
What you're setting up. A Slack app named VCL PMO Bot with two bot scopes (chat:write + files:write) installed to the Vimit Converters workspace. Its xoxb-… token goes into Frappe Cloud's site_config. The PMO page uses Slack's external-upload flow to render any plan as a VCL-branded A4 PDF and post it into #ai-pmo-plans (channel ID C0B5DA141MM).

Create the Slack app

Go to api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From scratch. Name it VCL PMO Bot. Pick the Vimit Converters workspace as the development workspace.

Add bot scopes

In the app sidebar → OAuth & Permissions. Under Scopes → Bot Token Scopes add both: chat:write (post the initial comment) and files:write (upload the PDF). Save.

Install + copy the token

Top of the same page → Install to Workspace → Allow. Copy the Bot User OAuth Token — it starts with xoxb-… Keep it on screen.

Invite the bot to the channel

In Slack, open #ai-pmo-plans and type: /invite @VCL PMO Bot. Confirm. The bot must be a channel member or files.completeUploadExternal returns not_in_channel.

Drop the token into Frappe Cloud site_config

SSH to the Frappe Cloud bench shell (or use the Bench → Site → Site Config UI). Run: bench --site vimitconverters.frappe.cloud set-config pmo_slack_bot_token "xoxb-…" bench --site vimitconverters.frappe.cloud set-config pmo_slack_plans_channel "C0B5DA141MM" The second line is optional — the default already points to #ai-pmo-plans.

Verify + troubleshoot

Open any plan in /app/pmo → click Send PDF to Slack. A green toast with a Slack permalink means it worked.

Toast saysWhat it means / fix
pmo_slack_bot_token not setThe site_config key is missing. Re-run step 5.
Slack post failed: not_in_channelBot isn't a member of #ai-pmo-plans. Re-run step 4.
Slack post failed: invalid_authToken was revoked or is the wrong type. Must be xoxb-… (Bot User), not xoxp-… (User).
Slack post failed: getUploadURLNetwork egress from Frappe Cloud is blocked, or files:write scope is missing. Re-check step 2.
